diagnosis: The view exposes internal store tax configurations and tax exemption account identifiers stored in django-constance based on store_code without validating store franchise association. Any authenticated user can extract regional tax settings and financial identifier codes of other franchises.
exploit_request:
GET /api/pos/stores/NYC_04/tax-config/ HTTP/1.1
Host: pos.retailchain.net
Authorization: Bearer <store_associate_jwt>
